description:
SUPERHOT is a first-person shooter where time only moves when you do. This
integration randomizes access to the game's 32 story levels.

v0.1.0.description:
Initial Release!

- Main Levels Added!
    - 31 levels including secrets as checks
    - Final level unlcoked after a configurable amount of levels finished.
v0.1.0.title: SUPERHOT Archipelago v0.1.0

v0.2.1.description:
## v0.2.1
- Added `AP MODE` toggle to turn Archipelago on/off without uninstalling
- Added item/check notification popups and an `AP LOG` history screen
- Consolidated hub buttons into one `ARCHIPELAGO` folder
- Added `exclude_slow_levels` option
- Fixed a save-corruption bug in secret tracking, and unlock state leaking between room connections
- Mod moved from Nexus Mods to Thunderstore, now installs MelonLoader as a dependency
v0.2.1.title: SUPERHOT Archipelago v0.2.1
